Name: Spaced Out
Summary:
Spaced Out

The Kyr'Ozch are constantly surrounding the Goliath-class battlestations in orbit around Rubi-Ka.

You're commissioned by the agency to investigate the disappearances of several people on Rubi-Ka.

One of them was last seen outside of Newland.

Name: Spaced Out: Escape the Ship
Summary: You have been abducted aboard an alien ship trap. Recover a Pulsing Clump from the Kyr'Ozch Hive Warden and give it to Shenna Marone or Roberto Belote, then stand on the center platform to escape.
